name: pivot_benchmark_relative_books
written: 2026-10-18 04:20, after the Round 6 B gate (dragon-tiger, margin, industry lead-lag fail within C_t; Northbound preliminary on 1,404 of ~3,600 names fails within C_t while its whole-curve top decile earns +17/+22/+36 bps per 5 days, t 2.2/2.8/4.1) and before any library or flow-input score was simulated as a benchmark-relative book
motivation: Round 6's diagnosis: every admission and objective statistic measures the whole score curve; the top-50 book earns only the top, and nothing found so far has long-side power inside the top 125 of the h5 score. The program's kill criterion for B says: if no outside data passes the within-C_t gate, pivot to benchmark-relative books (Round 5: add0.5 harvests the whole curve as under- and overweights; CSI1000 IR 2.0). The converse of the diagnosis is testable: a gain in the whole-curve statistic (RankIC) that never reached the top-50 book should reach a whole-curve book.

arms.P1 libraries: CSI300, 2018-2025, the existing 7-seed h5 runs with a mined library appended to Alpha158: lib_marginal (plain marginal rule, shipped default), lib_rp_block4, lib_rp_block4m, lib_rp_shrink25, lib_rp_shrink30, lib_rp_block4shrink (Round 6 C rules), lib_v41t5 (best DeepSeek arm). On the top-50 book these add +0.002..+0.004 RankIC and -0.35..+0.07 IR (none significant except shrink25, negative).
arms.P2 flow inputs: CSI300/CSI500/CSI1000, 2018-2025: the h5 model refitted with Alpha158 plus the 13 point-in-time flow features that are complete today (margin mg_fin_chg5/20, mg_buy5, mg_short_chg5, mg_fin_level; dragon-tiger lhb_on20/net20/last; industry lead-lag ll_lead5/20, ll_gap5, ll_ind5, ll_size_rank), 7 seeds, runs flow_h5_lgb_s*. Judged both as the top-50 tradable book (the standard comparison) and as the add0.5 book. A Northbound arm (nb_* features) follows when the fetch completes, under the same rule.

book: enhanced.py --tilt add0.5 --tilt excl0.2 --rate 0.1 --threshold 0.1 (the construction chosen in Round 5 on CSI300/CSI500 before CSI1000 was run), after cost, excess over the cost-free float-cap replica.
statistic: Paired difference in replica-relative IR between the arm's add0.5@r0.1 book and the h5 add0.5@r0.1 book on the same days (enhanced.py --compare, block-bootstrap 90% interval, book_eval._ir_diff_interval). The primary arm of P1 is lib_rp_shrink30 (best test retention and RankIC gain in Round 6 C); the primary comparison of P2 is add0.5 pooled over the three universes (cross_universe-style day-averaged differences, computed from the daily series).
decision: A pivot is supported when the primary arm's 90% interval lies above zero AND the sign agrees in at least two of the other P1 arms (or, for P2, in at least two of three universes). Then the program's objective moves to the whole-curve book: admission statistics stay as they are, the book changes. Otherwise the whole-curve gain does not reach any book and the Round 6 program closes with the top-of-curve null: the long side of Alpha158 plus available outside data is exhausted; the remaining value is in the benchmark-relative book of the existing score.
no_peeking: The h5 add0.5 baselines exist from Round 5 (enhanced/grinold_<u>.json, add0.5@r0.1 CSI300 1.11 / CSI500 (grid) / CSI1000 2.02 replica-relative). No arm's benchmark-relative series has been computed.
P1_result: 2026-10-18 04:50: add0.5 primary rp_shrink30 +0.32 [+0.10, +0.53] (NW t 2.2), all six other arms positive (+0.05..+0.15), reality check over 7 arms p 0.083; excl0.2 +0.37 [+0.09, +0.67], all positive, p 0.091. Per window (2018/20/22/24) shrink30 -0.02/+0.20/+0.53/+0.42. Rule met on CSI300.

transfer.written: 2026-10-18 04:55, before any CSI500 library export, fit or book
transfer.why: Every P1 library was mined on CSI300 panels and shrink30 was named primary from CSI300 test statistics (Round 6 C), so a CSI500 result is the first genuinely untouched data for this question. CSI1000 has no FactorMiner panel and is left out.
transfer.arms: The three P1 arms with distinct provenance: lib_rp_shrink30 (primary), lib_marginal (shipped rule), lib_v41t5 (different miner). Each CSI300 per-window library (the export's factors.csv name/formula) is evaluated on the CSI500 panel for the same window (evaluate_library.py, csi500_wf*.yaml = csi300 config with the universe changed), appended to Alpha158 under h5, 7 seeds, runs lib_<arm>_h5_lgb_s* in output/qlib_cn/csi500/wf*; then add0.5@r0.1 and excl0.2@r0.1 against the CSI500 h5 books, and the top-50 tradable book as the standard comparison.
transfer.decision: Transfer supported when CSI500 add0.5 dIR of the primary arm is positive and the CSI300+CSI500 pooled (day-averaged paired difference) 90% interval lies above zero, with at least one of the two other arms positive on CSI500. If CSI500 is negative for the primary arm, P1 is read as a CSI300-only result and the pivot stays provisional.

verdict: Pivot supported: the program's objective moves to the whole-curve (benchmark-relative) book; admission statistics stay as they are.
